hypotheses: The published income_yield_pct (2.4, 2.1, 2.8) is not any ratio the page prints: the 10-Q for 2023-09-30 prints 'Ratio of net investment income (loss) after taxes to average net assets (4)(5)(9) 6.8 % 2.2 %' (nine months, not annualised), the 10-Q for 2023-06-30 '4.0 % ( 0.5 )%' (six months). The 2023-09-30 instance has no InvestmentCompanyInvestmentIncomeLossRatio fact, so the published figure comes from companyfacts on a context I did not trace. distribution_rate is annualised from monthly 0.18 / 0.19 distributions (8.4, 8.8 pct), so F16 compares an annualised rate with what looks like a single-quarter ratio; annualised (x4) the ratio would pass the check in all three quarters.

2022-12-31: the only distribution of the year, 0.75 declared 12/19/2022, is annualised as a quarterly figure (11.9 pct); the fund operated only from mid-2022 ('The Company did not commence operations as of December 31, 2022' refers to the Company before the merger with the Private BDC).

Fix would be highlights figure_corrections for income_yield_pct with the printed ratio (as Monroe), but the printed ratio is year-to-date and not annualised, so it is not comparable either; I did not choose a basis. Also: distribution_rate and income_yield_pct are empty from 2023-12-31 on (coverage gap, no finding).
